appWallets.savedRecoveryFiles.title: Recovery file saved on this device
appWallets.savedRecoveryFiles.plaintextB: An earlier export left a recovery file for this wallet in this app's Documents folder. It contains the recovery phrase and private key in readable form.
appWallets.savedRecoveryFiles.encryptedB: An earlier export left an encrypted recovery file for this wallet in this app's Documents folder.
appWallets.savedRecoveryFiles.beforeRemo: Before you remove it, make sure you have saved the recovery phrase somewhere safe. Removing it cannot be undone.
appWallets.savedRecoveryFiles.removed: The saved recovery files were removed from this device.
appWallets.savedRecoveryFiles.removeFail: Some recovery files could not be removed. Please try again.
